in_marathi.name: Niti
in_marathi.long_meaning: Niti हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Niti is a Sanskrit word derived from the root 'nit' which means 'rule' or 'direction'. In Hindu mythology, Niti is considered the goddess of righteousness and morality. She is also known as the 'Goddess of Good Conduct'.
